text: help me understand something. so in the painter. i go and i paint some random scribbles, i save it as sss, and i see it now in my material list. how come i cannot use this for skins on walls/floors now ?
resolution: Explained the current painter/material/skin routing. A saved painter document is editable library source data, not a texture-registry material id; building skins only accept color or material ids that resolve through textureById/assignableMaterialCatalog. The existing usable paths are materialize/apply from a building paint target, or extract a cutout then materialize it into a custom: texture. No code changed for this explanatory request.
